note: Header fields are read directly from the input file and control later allocation and scanline processing.
The parsed dimensions are used to allocate the destination image before any validation of zero-sized dimensions.
The implementation should reject zero width or height before constructing the QImage; that safety obligation is violated because the check happens after allocation.
Later scanline writes assume a valid, non-empty image; with malformed or truncated input this access becomes invalid and triggers the sanitizer-reported failure.
